title: AOS-Bench: Can LLM Agents Manage Dynamic Workloads?
abstract: arXiv:2610.33178v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents are moving from handling one request at a time to serving as persistent assistants to which users hand a stream of work: a build, a data-processing job and a bug fix may all be pending on the same machine at once. Such an agent must decide when to take on new tasks, how to delegate and overlap them, and how to stay within the machine's CPU and memory. Existing benchmarks cannot measure this, because they evaluate each task in isolation. We introduce \benchname{}, which evaluates an agent system as a workload manager: verified tasks arrive over time and must be delivered under shared CPU and memory limits, and the same tasks run one at a time serve as a per-system reference.   Across five model--harness pairs, isolated task success does not carry over evenly. On heavy workloads every system loses 13 to 23 points. translated_title: AOS-Bench：大语言模型智能体能管理动态工作负载吗？
translated_abstract: 编程智能体正在从一次只处理一个请求，转变为作为持续在线的助手来接收用户交来的工作流：一次构建、一个数据处理作业和一个错误修复可能同时挂起在同一台机器上。这样的智能体必须决定何时接手新任务、如何委派和重叠执行任务，以及如何将运行控制在机器的 CPU 和内存限制之内。现有的基准测试无法衡量这一点，因为它们都是孤立地评估每个任务。我们提出 AOS-Bench，它将智能体系统作为一个工作负载管理器来评估：经过验证的任务随时间不断到达，必须在共享的 CPU 和内存限制下按时交付，而相同的任务逐个单独运行则作为每个系统各自的参照基准。在五组模型—运行框架组合上的实验表明，孤立任务上的成功并不能均匀地延续到流式场景中。在重负载下，所有系统的性能都损失了 13 到 23 分。在中等负载下，各系统在孤立任务成功率上相差 11 分，但在流式成功率上相差达 26 分，且两个系统……
tldr: 本文提出 AOS-Bench，首个将 LLM 智能体作为“工作负载管理器”评估的基准——任务随时间流式到达并需在共享 CPU 与内存限制下交付——揭示了孤立任务上的成功无法反映智能体在动态多任务场景下的真实能力（重负载下所有系统损失 13 至 23 分）。
en_tdlr: AOS-Bench is the first benchmark that evaluates LLM agents as workload managers—verified tasks arrive over time and must be delivered under shared CPU and memory constraints—revealing that isolated task success does not transfer to dynamic multi-task workloads, with every system losing 13 to 23 points under heavy loads.
